verdict.rationale: Workspace export with full history (comments, attachments, audit trails) is a fair question for a work-management SaaS like Asana, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no first-party export feature. The REST API and third-party extractors (Fivetran, Airbyte, Skyvia) are developer building blocks and external tools, and the agent audit trail is an adjacent governance feature; none of these count as an export capability.
